title: nvim process crash when I do nvr

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
<!-- Before reporting: search existing issues and check the FAQ. -->

- `nvim --version`: v0.5.0-295-g234232ff4 (this is the crash dump version - but it happens in v0.5.0-418 too) 
- Operating system/version: MACOS 
- Terminal name/version: goneovim 

### Actual behaviour
Hi,

Neovim's process crashes when I run the following script:

/Users/eyalkarni/.pyenv/shims/nvr --nostart --servername `cat /tmp/curserver` --remote-send "$1GzOzz"


where $1 contains the line number.

I run this script when I do what is known as a backward search from skim. It is triggered by double click. If I do double click too fast, neovim process crashes - both in goneovim and in neovim-qt , but not in the original nvim. Yet, the crashing process is nvim. 

Now, it doesn't happen when I tried to run it in a loop in sh. Just when I double click the mouse to trigger it and just sometimes. So, I wasn't able to reproduce it in a comfortable way. But it happens a lot. 
This is nightly version. I wanted to generate a better crash dump , but couldn't compile neovim. 
It didn't work. Tell me what details you want, the crash dump is 1.35 gb.
